notes.title: Qorena Update - Version 0.9.3
notes.content:
Last update, we released the Campaign Update, introducing the new game mode for mission scenario action with friends and/or bots. Now we brought 4 more missions into the fray!

[list]
[*] Aquamarine - Infiltrate the docks to steal plans for an experimental submarine.
[*] Scorch - Storm the beach, fight your way through an airfield, and liberate a suburban village.
[*] Valheim - March through a cold blizzard, destroy artillery, find an obscure base, and steal docs from a winter village town.
[*] Veritas - Storm through a moving train (be it from floor or top), slaughter your way to the engine room to hijack the train. Slog through a wet jungle marsh and rescue pinned down allies. Assault a castle with your comrades.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=D1xCPgocIkU;full][/previewyoutube][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/5ecbb73b77c1a927529dc9d4f92527053ed907f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/d93957617c590a7fcd9e6eea8665fd1df0047b7f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/37f2ed17a27c5f3b04ff8e00e1f991a518419d58.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/464ce4b5e50aa30e846ee6bda65152248f9dc785.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/5ebc9ead5dadd62a42eb8c645c000b040818dcc2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/9a667729ec6b5f85c5e64ec71f5a907d948880b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Campaign: 4 new missions.
[*] Grenade perk icon now changes according to the perk collected.
[*] The Customizer now has background music and ambiance.
[*] The Score Streaker has been improved, allowing for multiple simulatenous streaks displayed on screen.
[*] The Navigation Marker system has been improved, allowing for multiple nav markers displayed on screen.
[*] The player's customizer sprites are now positioned properly even during online matches.
[*] The player's customizer sprites are now fully bright and almost fully colorable (sans weapons).
[*] Screen-space reflections and Global illumination are now being utilized.
[*] New Customer Headwear: Conical Hat
[*] New Customer Headwear: Imperial Helmet
[*] The original "Helmet" has been renamed to "Knight's Helmet".
[/list]

[h1]COMING SOON:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Level Editor - Create your own custom levels for survival mode, or mission packs for campaign mode!
[/list]

[h1]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/h1]

[i]The settings, map cycle, and customizer storage system has been updated. You may have to resave your respective content in order for the effects to properly apply. For instance, and as a result, chances are your mannequins will look brighter or paler than usual.[/i]

[h1]MATCHMAKING:[/h1]

​If you want to find players to play this game with (in the event the server browser is empty), you can [url=https://discord.com/invite/mW4ZHuq]join our Discord server​[/url].
___

We hope you will enjoy playing Qorena with this bountiful update.

notes.title: Qorena Update - Version 0.9.1
notes.content:
It has been a while since this game was updated. Important fixes to the game has been applied along with a major graphical revamp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/e6b9f207787aef9ba7ac26aedd4e056d21091afb.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=M_vWAczdtKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1]

[list]
[*] The map cycle feature has been fixed completely. You can now add any maps you desire into the cycle and they will be played in the order of top to bottom (and rinse and repeat).
[*] You can now play levels in rotating fashion in Instant Action just as you can in online Multiplayer. Initially, you could only play the 1st level from the cycle which would restart that same level after each match.
[*] Restore Upgrades on Death finally works.
[*] Cloud storage saves are now properly functional for Qorena. The old Maze Qore Arena cloud storage is deprecated from this game.
[/list]

[h1]COMING SOON:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Campaign Update - Play a series of mission packs alone or with friends in the new Campaign mode!
[*] Level Editor - Create your own custom levels for survival mode, or mission packs for campaign mode!
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy playing Qorena more than we did working on it. There will be a sale coming soon in the Summer. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049640/Qorena/?curator_clanid=9123326]Wishlist us[/url] on Steam for updates on sales and more updates like this.

notes.title: Qorena Released out of Early Access!
notes.content:
After 4 years, Qorena is finally out of Early Access and onto full release! Those of you who downloaded the game during the EA already got to keep it free. Others will have to buy it now at standard price.

[previewyoutube=3CgrizvYLu8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2][/b]

[h3]Improved Spectator Menu[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/fd077aeb9c71389ca8716480a81c89012186c69e.png[/img]
Players can now access spectator mode at the pause menu. This will undeploy the player. If you wish to join the fray again, click Play on the spectator panel. Assuming "Allow Late Join" is enabled in settings, the player will deploy instantly, otherwise they will be deployed in the next peacetime interval.

[h3]Map Cycle List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/0bd43d94e4ee4a23bd28b694d63e3ceee7b01464.png[/img]
You can now add levels into the map cycle list. This list will also be used to switch to a new map from the Spectator Menu, so add the ones you wish to switch between in your server.

[h3]Music[/h3]
The game now features sequential music, relative to certain levels.

[h3]Config Presets[/h3]
You can find this in the game's installation directory >> Config >> Presets.
Make a backup, adjust your parameters, and update configurations in your App Data directory. Instructions are in the presets folder.

[b][h2]PLANNED FEATURES: POST-RELEASE[/h2][/b]

[h3]Mod Support[/h3]
This was originally planned in this release, however that proved to be too ambitious to work on, especially when we are still not convinced enough players will care for the game enough to justify it, so we moved it to post-release. We will only work on it, if and when we can see reasonable player activity in the game. A good (but not the sole) indicator for us if the game unlocks the ability to use trading cards.

[b][h1]IMPORTANT: FOR EARLY-ACCESS OWNERS[/h1][/b]
A LOT has changed since the overhaul. You will have to reinstall your game for the latest changes to take effect. The new installation folder changed from "Maze Qore Arena" to "Qorena". Mannequin saves may also break so be sure to back those up before you uninstall and reinstall.
_______________

That is all. Hope you all enjoy playing this game.

notes.title: Maze Qore Arena Update & Plans for Overhaul - Version 0.7.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/b1aa2126274495c55a92f534edf05d02caac5a2d.jpg[/img]
Greetings!

The new 0.7 update for Maze Qore Arena is now available!

In this update, we have been hard at work to deliver yet another a new game mode, and a few more new levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/c9a4e49cb6edc0c16b8ea88b97eae5bd64f8f6a8.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW GAME MODE: IDENTITY THEFT:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/0d37cee70067c925631133e440533397ebd42bbd.gif[/img]

Steal the ID card, escape the area or kill all the other players to win! Player with the fastest completion time wins!

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]New game mode: Identity Theft.[/b]
[*] New map: Outdoors - Imperial Base.
[*] New map: Outdoors - Deserted Town.
[*] Introduced a PS1/PC-classic graphics aesthetic.
[*] Improved the AI to perform better with Flag Hustle, and the Riots.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN BUGS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bot AI may still have a few hiccups with Identity Theft. We might work towards fixing it in a patch.
[/list]


[h1]MOST IMPORTANT NEWS[/h1]

As this year comes to a close, we've been deciding long and hard with what to do with this game. Despite our efforts, nigh no one seems to care that this game even exists as it has languished for months with no online servers populated with players (let alone at least one server to join), and almost no activity. Either that, or they probably played the outdated singleplayer demo and forgot about the entire game afterwards. For all we know, we are unsure if anyone is probably even reading these update articles.

So considering this and the research on how competitive multiplayer games fare on this marketplace, we've concluded that competitive multiplayer is a fruitless endeavor. We really want to give players a reason to care for this game, and most importantly enjoy the game, for our success can only be achieved when players are enjoying this game.

Starting next year (and part of our resolution for 2022), Maze Qore Arena will be overhauled. It will no longer feature competitive gameplay as it currently stands. Instead, it shall live closer to it's name; an Arena; a coliseum of enemies to slay; a might and fight for survival. MQA is going cooperative.

[h1]WHAT ABOUT THE CONTENT?[/h1]

Most of the pre-existing levels, sprites, and gameplay will remain intact. The game modes will be scrapped and replaced with only one; Survival.

NPCs from the old singleplayer demo will make their return to the overhaul.

Bots will be overhauled to specifically support this game mode, so hopefully you will not have to fight alone against waves offline.

This also means MQA might compete with the likes of Killing Floor when it comes to it's new gameplay direction (even though we're not trying to compete with them).

From the beginning of this game development, we wanted to provide a variety of gameplay options for players to enjoy including the Survival mode (eventually), however we've learned that MP games for the most part have gone nowhere, often dead-on arrival. We tried to rectify this with bot support, giving players an alternative to at least still enjoy the game offline should online disappoint.

We've learned that sometimes. it is better to keep it simple and straight-forward, rather than try to make an online game suite.

Hopefully all goes well.

_____________

I hope you enjoyed this update and thanks for playing Maze Qore Arena!

notes.title: Maze Qore Arena Multi-player Update - Version 0.6.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/5b6b3fec8b5a0ede2e3cea764c6f6f803c4f8ccd.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

The new 0.6 update for Maze Qore Arena is now available!

In this update, we have been hard at work to deliver a new game mode, and several more new levels!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EnV6bmLXcAAY3iV?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EnV6bqpXcAYR8Cd?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EnV6bmdXMAETZHQ?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EnV6bmOWEAAOkHE?format=jpg&name=large[/img]


[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]New game mode: Jail Bait.[/b]
[*] New map: Yellow Sector - Fahrenheit.
[*] New map: Red Sector - Peer Pressure.
[*] New map: Quarantine Zone - Doctor Sid's Lab.
[*] New map: Grey Sector - The Killing Floor.
[*] New map: Dream Sector - Cloud Nine.
[*] Fixed bugs with the audio and multiplayer settings.
[*] Fixed bug preventing a match from loading it's respective settings.
[*] Polished the bot AI to perform better with Flag Hustle and Jail Bait.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN BUGS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bot AI is still a WIP; finally playable with Flag Hustle and experimental with Jail Bait.
[*] Players may seldom disconnect as the server changes to a new level.
[*] Players may be unable to rejoin the same server they were abruptly disconnected from, requiring a restart of the game.
[*] Instant Action: Bots have trouble navigating through teleporters, seldom rendering some maps unplayable on certain game modes (Flag Hustle and Jail Bait).
[*] Teleporter sounds lack proper attenuation; sounds will still play as if you are close by. For this reason, it is recommended to play Doctor Sid's Lab and Cloud Nine with at most 4 players/bots to reduce noise spam. Expect a patch soon to remedy this.
[/list]

After feedback from the team, we decided to alter our plan for the final release and post-support. We will take our chances introducing mod support before early access ends and hope for the best. We may have been looking at this the wrong and realized the potential the game truly has beyond just an action-arena, E-sports-friendly, shooter. We want to make it modular and expand the game with multiple themes to suit the gamer's preference, somewhat similar to Prison Architect only better. As a spin-off to our [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/maze-qore]main project[/url], we now seek to expand this game outside the confines of a prison, and we will start showing this by the next update version 0.7 with more outdoor levels and another new game mode.

By version 0.8, we will bring two more new game modes, and a handful of game themes (to be discussed when that time comes).

By version 0.9, bot support should be completed, and mod tools released in beta phase.

By the end of early access (1.0), mod tools will leave beta, completing the entire project.

Post release may see two additional game modes, and a series of holiday events for two years.

_____________

I hope you enjoyed this update and thanks for playing Maze Qore Arena!

notes.title: Maze Qore Arena Multi-player Now Available! [Version 0.5.0]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/43c1a8229a2654b59a4fbf7549618254280083a2.jpg[/img]

Initially, we stated prior sometime in the past that multiplayer will mark the day Maze Qore Arena leaves early access with a price tag, but after some months deciding hard on it, and re-evaluating the quality of the single-player component, we decided to release the first multiplayer update free into early access, and we will continue this tradition until Version 1.0, which will mark the full release out of early access.

In addition, we have already decided to make the singleplayer version a separate component via 'demo' release, available on the front page.

Now please note. this game is still not complete, let alone feature complete. We still have plenty of features to complete before the game leaves early access. At this point, due to personal reasons related to COVID-19, we can no longer guarantee it will leave early access before the end of 2020 as we had hoped, but we still intend to ensure it does, hopefully no later than Holiday 2020.

As for post-support, well to be honest with you all, that all depends on how well this game performs and how much the players care. We are willing to devote our time and efforts to supporting this game to be polished and complete, even after early access, however there is little purpose to do so if it is dead on arrival. To help prevent this phenomenon that many multiplayer titles succumb to, we are working on bots (player AI substitutes) to fail-safe this game from such predicament. As it stands now in V0.5, they are unready, and to a point where some game modes can be unplayable due to behavior. This shall be fixed in Version 0.6 or 0.7. Regarding mod support, this will also be completed during post-support for the very fears aforementioned - no point in mod support if no one cares about the game.

[h1]KNOWN BUGS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bot AI is a broken mess, yet they are fairly playable on Riot and Gang Riot.
[*] Players may seldom disconnect as the server changes to a new level.
[*] Players may be unable to rejoin the same server they were abruptly disconnected from, requiring a restart of the game.
[*] Score streaks are still a work-in-progress, thus you may experience an "unknown scorestreak" message, often when you kill multiple enemies.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Many features from singleplayer have been transferred to this multiplayer build, with necessary changes and omissions to balance online play.
[*] Players have the ability throw grenades and carry up to 8 at a time. Subject to change.
[/list]


_____________

I hope you enjoyed this update and thanks for playing Maze Qore Arena!

[i]Establish, Explore, Expand.[/i]

_____________

[h2]QUICK UPDATE[/h2]

If you are having trouble finding a multiplayer server to play on, or finding players to play with, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mW4ZHuq]Discord server[/url] to lobby for players and join a match together.

Use !register to access the server, then use the #gaming channel to host a session to other gamers.

notes.title: Maze Qore Arena Single-player Update - Version 0.4.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667700/8ebac0d771637f21eaccf55d81e3c41483770a6b.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

The new 0.4 update for Maze Qore Arena is now available!

Today's update is a very special one. As we focus on the multiplayer side of our game, we decided to review the overall quality of our project. After surveying the game and analyzing feedback from gamers and critics who've tried our game, we realized the previous art style the game released with is not adequate for today's gaming market. We wanted to go for an unlit, cartoon style synonymous with flash games from Newgrounds and with our philosophy, we expected the gameplay to stand out more and make up for the unlit 2D style. This did not seem to work as well as we had hoped. We had also realized we missed many opportunities to improve the gameplay as is to make it stand out from your generic flash game shooter. So we decided to overhaul the graphics and improve the gameplay to make it feel more like a game worth playing.

Here are the changes made with this update:


[list]
[*] Levels have been graphically overhauled, applying lighting effects and reflections whenever and wherever necessary.
[*] Some effects (like explosions) now glow in darkness.
[*] Some props (like Black-Ops crates and explosive barrels) now have screen-space reflections.
[*] Camera shake effects have been applied to the game. Whenever the player shoots, or takes damage, the camera will animate.
[*] Camera effects vary based on weapons and damage types. For instance, a rifle or pistol will cause a minor shake; machine gun fire will shingle the screen; a hit from a psychic blast will disorient the player.
[*] Character sprites now blend with the environment.
[*] Removed a max ammo limit bug with the grenade feature (the limit was meant for multiplayer and somehow it crept into single-player). You should now be able to collect grenades infinitely.
[*] NPCs health have decreased by either one half or one third (depending on the type of enemies and allies).
[/list]

From hence on, we do not plan to update the single-player mode from this point save for perhaps a few patches. It seems we've done as much as possible to improve this side of the game. The only possible two updates for single-player remaining are:

[list]
[*] Linux AArch64 support.
[*] Steam Achievements.
[*] Any necessary patches for the game.
[/list]

As also stated in the previous 0.3 update, we are deprecating support for Windows 32-bit operating systems. Epic Games has overhauled the cooking and packaging infrastructure and thus effectively rendered 32-bit impossible to work with it unless we flip a switch in the project settings in Unreal Editor. Since they also stated in their engine version notes they will deprecate 32-bit support in 4.26, and remove it higher versions, we decided to deprecate support now.

As it stands, version 0.4 of Maze Qore Arena will be the final version to support 32-bit OS and thus will be played in single player only. Once MQA reaches version 1.0 (and leaves early access) we will remove 32-bit support entirely. Seems the 32-bit era is sadly coming to an end. Now is the time to upgrade to 64-bit computers if you have not already done so.

If you wish to play the single player in 32-bit after this point, the retail version will still be available on the game's [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/MazeQoreArena/317243]Game Jolt[/url] page.

_____________

[h1][b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b][/h1]

Singleplayer and Multiplayer builds have been separated and renamed. For those tech savvy, you may notice in the file directory that the Maze Qore Arena folder now has SP and MP folders to separate the two halves, this has as a result broken the save storage for the game so if you have played earlier versions here is how to fix this:

[olist]
[*] Access directory [code]"C:/Users/ <[i][u]Your Computer Name[/u][/i]> /AppData/Local"[/code]
[*] Rename the "MazeQoreArena" folder to "MQA_SP"
[/olist]

If MQA_SP already exists. Delete the folder before following the above steps.


Ultimately, it may be best to start anew instead as a few changes in the game has occurred however nothing that should corrupt saves.

_____________

I hope you enjoyed this update and thanks for playing Maze Qore Arena!

[i]- Establish. Explore. Expand.[/i]


_____

EDIT: Bugs found. Patch inbound.

tags.feature: Levels have been graphically overhauled, applying lighting effects and reflections whenever and wherever necessary.
Some effects (like explosions) now glow in darkness.
Some props (like Black-Ops crates and explosive barrels) now have screen-space reflections.
Camera shake effects have been applied to the game. Whenever the player shoots, or takes damage, the camera will animate.

Camera effects vary based on weapons and damage types. For instance, a rifle or pistol will cause a minor shake; machine gun fire will shingle the screen; a hit from a psychic blast will disorient the player.
Character sprites now blend with the environment.

tags.bug: Removed a max ammo limit bug with the grenade feature (the limit was meant for multiplayer and somehow it crept into single-player). You should now be able to collect grenades infinitely.

tags.balance_change: NPCs health have decreased by either one half or one third (depending on the type of enemies and allies).

tags.feature: Linux AArch64 support.
Steam Achievements.

notes.title: Maze Qore Arena Single-player Update - Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
Greetings!

We have released a new minor update for Maze Qore Arena, which fixes a few bugs and polishes the game with new features, as well as pave the way for the upcoming multiplayer update.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Most objects above the player now fade when overlapping with the camera view distance. This is known as CVOF (Camera View Object Fading). For instance, if you enter buildings with a 'roof' they will fade instead of blocking your way.
[*] To complement CVOF, few structures are no longer transparent by default, such as those in the Yellow Sector missions.
[/list]


[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Upgraded to Unreal Engine 4.25.
[*] Added folder directory path preparation for the multiplayer release (for the tech savvy).
[*] Deprecating 32-bit support for Windows support soon due to changes with in Unreal Engine 4.25.
[/list]

___

[i]Establish, Explore, Expand[/i]
